Mira Risk Engine

Official report: detect risk, size it, act. Backtest 2001-2026 and strict 2025-2026 test.
Version 1.0, 2026-10-15. Project: Mira (U-Hackathon Flow Summit). Research only. No real money. Not investment advice.
Read first. This is a historical backtest with a fixed rule set. It is not a forecast and not a promise of return. Markets can fall further than any past period. For real money, speak to a licensed adviser.

1. Summary

-8%worst fall, Mira chain 60%, vs -33% fixed and -51% all-stocks
+5.9%growth a year, Mira chain 60% (fixed +6.2%, all-stocks +8.8%)
0.76Sharpe over cash (fixed 0.52)
5 of 26calendar years the chain beat fixed 60%

The engine watches the S&P 500 for three danger signs, estimates how bad one month could be, and lowers the stock share when risk is high. Over 25 years it kept a growth rate close to a fixed 60% stock mix while avoiding the deepest falls. In the calm 2025-2026 window it gave up growth because there was little to protect against.

Best points: shallow falls in the dot-com bust, the 2008 crisis and Covid; a high Sharpe ratio; it works with a plain cash fallback; the rules are simple enough to explain to a first-time investor.
Weak points: it sometimes cuts stocks just before a rebound (April 2025, March 2026); it cannot see a sudden fall that starts from a calm market; its edge is avoiding deep falls, not extra return.

2. How it works

StepWhat it doesRule (fixed before testing)
1 DetectThree alarms on the S&P 500 at month end20-day volatility > 1.5 x 250-day; drawdown ≥ 10% from the 1-year high; price below the 200-day average. Stress = number of alarms (0-3)
2 SizeOne bad month at 95% confidence1.645 x the higher of 20/60-day volatility x √21. Stock share allowed by a 4% monthly risk budget
3 ActStock share = lower of base dial and risk-budget share, times a gateGate by stress: 0 = 100%, 1 = 75%, 2 = 50%, 3 = 25%. The rest sits in cash (long test) or a defensive multi-asset core

Costs: 10 basis points on every change. Decisions at month end use only data known then; money works the next month. Leak test: 12 of 12 random months gave the identical signal with future prices removed.

5. Crises and what the detector saw

Crisis, cumulative returnFixed 60%Gate 60%Mira chain 60%
Dot-com 2001-01..2002-10-16.9%-7.3%-5.0%
GFC 2007-10..2009-03-25.9%-12.2%-6.0%
Covid 2020-01..03-5.1%-4.7%-5.4%
2022 bear 2021-12..2022-10-7.1%-6.6%-4.5%

Stress 2 or 3 came before 11 of the 13 one-month falls of 8% or more. After stress 3, the next month fell 5% or more in 46% of months (13 months, a small sample). Stress is a volatility-regime gauge, not a crash forecast: falls that start from a calm market are not seen in time.

6. Strict test, 2025-2026

Decisions from January 2025, after the training cutoff of the AI model used elsewhere in the project. Signals were checked for look-ahead. Defensive side: the multi-asset core. 19 months.

60% baseGrowth a yearWorst fallSharpe
Fixed 60% stocks+12.5%-4.0%1.03
Risk gate 60%+10.4%-3.9%0.90
Mira chain 60% (detect-size-act)+7.5%-3.8%0.59

The market was calm; the worst fall for the fixed mix was about -4%. The declared success rule is inconclusive. The gate lowered growth because it cut stocks in April 2025 and March 2026, before rebounds.

7. Honest limits

  • The rules were fixed before the runs, but the authors saw the 2008-2026 results. Only the forward test is unseen.
  • 2017-2026: the chain did not meet the declared success rule (stocks mostly rose; protection cost growth).
  • Few independent crises (about four). Intervals on return differences include zero: the benefit is shallower falls, not extra return.
  • The long test uses plain cash as the defensive side and the S&P 500 only; taxes and fees beyond 10 bps are not modelled.
  • The AI news layer did not beat the statistical anchor in the sealed 2025-2026 test, so its weight in the system is 10%.

8. Forward test (pre-registered)

The rule was frozen on 2026-10-15 with a code hash and a monthly ledger. Decisions logged so far: 1. A verdict needs 12 scored months and starts from October 2026 returns. A code change makes the program refuse to run.

9. Reproduce

Code and data snapshot: risk-system_SNAPSHOT_2026-10-15_mira.zip. Commands: python -E mira_invest.py, python -E mira_sandbox_tests.py, python -E mira_official_report.py. Tests: 19 suites, all passing.
